args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE transparent 4 by 4 sprite sheet, sixteen equally sized square cells, read left to right, top to bottom. This replaces a noisy tiny calendar pet. Reference images1 and2 are original Victamin design authorities, not a background to reproduce.
Draw the SAME cute limbless Victamin in every cell. Preserve exactly two tall rounded upright rabbit-like ears, left inner ear orange/right inner ear yellow, cream/white layered rectangular paper-tab pompom body, two orange square cheeks, dark tiny eyes and smile. NO arms, hands, legs, feet, hats, props, speech, text or ground shadow. Simplify the overlapping rectangular tabs into a few broad readable groups. Keep the recognizable layered-paper silhouette, never fur spikes or a plain rabbit. Clean soft matte cel illustration, smooth antialiased edges, consistent medium warm-taupe outline, sparse interior seams. Warm ivory/soft butter yellow/apricot palette fits a tidy cream calendar. No pixel dithering, noise, hairs, sketch texture, bloom, translucent white haze, tiny busy lines or photorealism.
Each cell has the same scale, centered face/body registration and ground baseline at88% of the cell; keep all ears and body inside with generous transparent margins. Draw shallow three-quarter facing RIGHT wherever awake so horizontal mirroring indicates travel. Camera, proportions, layer arrangement and light remain consistent; change only the specified pose/expression. The body is rounded and wider than tall, with long ears above, no limbs.
Cells1–4: neutral alert; gentle blink; tiny rightward scoot compression; rightward scoot extension.
Cells5–8: anticipatory crouch; joyful upward jump ears trail slightly; falling with ears lifting slightly; soft squash landing.
Cells9–12: picked up, squirming body/ears; delighted closed-eye smile; sleepy yawn; sleeping closed eyes, settled rounded body, ears relaxed but still present.
Cells13–16: waking half-open eyes; small pleased heart-tap bounce without heart icon; shy low crouch peeking; alert reappearance.
The changes are subtle coherent animation keyposes, not sixteen different mascots. No grids or cell borders. Genuine transparent background.
